sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Matilda The Musical celebrated fifteen years since its London debut. The production premiered in Stratford-upon-Avon in 2010 before moving to the West End.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The show became a major theatre success, reaching over twelve million people globally, playing thousands of performances, and winning numerous international awards.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The musical continues its West End run with tickets available until January 2027, alongside a tour across the UK and Ireland.
